# Realization Mode

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:RealizationMode`](gmeow-RealizationMode.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/RealizationMode>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The mode in which a musical [`Expression`](gmeow-Expression.md) realizes its [`Work`](gmeow-Work.md) — a VALUE vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses). The oral-tradition guarantee requires that no shape ever mandate a notated realization.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:RealizationMode`](gmeow-RealizationMode.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for how a musical [`Expression`](gmeow-Expression.md) is realized — notated, performed, improvised, oral, machine-generated; referenced by [`gmeow:realizationMode`](../properties/gmeow-realizationMode.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid splitting [`Expression`](gmeow-Expression.md) into notated/performed subclasses ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)) and never let a shape mandate the notated mode (the oral-tradition guarantee).

### How to use

- Reference a seeded [`gmeow:RealizationMode`](gmeow-RealizationMode.md) individual from an [`Expression`](gmeow-Expression.md) via [`gmeow:realizationMode`](../properties/gmeow-realizationMode.md); extend with new individuals (not subclasses) when a new mode appears.

### Examples

- [`gmeow:realizationModeNotated`](../individuals/gmeow-realizationModeNotated.md) a [`gmeow:RealizationMode`](gmeow-RealizationMode.md).
